title: Create your account
tagline: Sign up in a few minutes, as a customer or as a pro
transcript: In this video, you will create your Trothen account, step by step. It takes about three minutes, and it is free.
You need your phone number and an email address that you can open, because we send you a code to finish.
Tap Sign In, at the top of the screen.
You do not have an account yet, so tap Sign Up.
First, choose how you will use Trothen. Choose Provider if you will offer your own work, like cleaning, repairs, or driving.
Choose Customer if you want to hire pros, book rides, or buy in the Market. In this video, we choose Customer.
Type your full name, the way it is written on your ID. Later, when you verify your identity, the names must match.
Choose your country. Prices, phone numbers and counties then follow your country.
Choose your county.
Type your phone number. Pros and drivers never see it: calls and messages go through the app.
Type your city or town, so we show you pros near you.
Type your email address. Make sure it is one you can open now.
Choose a password of at least eight characters. Use letters, numbers and a sign, and do not use it anywhere else.
Tap Create Account.
We then email you a six-digit code. Type the code in, and your account is ready.
Did not get the code? Check your spam folder, wait a minute, then ask for a new code.
Already have an account? Tap Sign In instead, and type your email and password. That is all.

title: Verify your identity
tagline: Send your ID once, so people know you are who you say
transcript: In this video, you will verify your identity. Everyone on Trothen does this once, so customers, pros and drivers know who they are dealing with.
You need your ID card, passport or driver's licence, and a phone camera. Find a place with good light.
On your home screen, tap Verify Now.
Choose the kind of document you have: a national ID card, a passport, or a driver's licence.
Type your name exactly as it is printed on the document, with the same spelling.
Take a photo of the front of your document. Lay it flat, fill the photo with it, and make sure every word can be read.
Then take a photo of the back. A passport has no back, so you can leave this one out.
Then take a photo of your face. Look straight at the camera, with no hat and no sunglasses.
Before you send them, check the photos. A blurred photo, or one with light shining on it, is the most common reason we ask again.
When everything is clear, tap Submit for Review.
A person on our team checks it, usually within 48 hours. We tell you by email, and on your home screen.
Your photos are kept private. Only the team that checks them can see them, and they are never shown to other people.

title: Post a job
tagline: Tell pros what you need, and get a clear price
transcript: In this video, you will post a job, so that pros near you can offer to do it. There are four short steps.
On your home screen, tap Post a New Job.
Step one: what you need.
Type the kind of work, for example cleaning, plumbing, or braids. The list below gets shorter as you type.
Tap the kind of work that fits best. If nothing fits, choose Something else at the bottom of the list.
Describe the job: what needs doing, where in the house, and how big it is. The more you say, the better the prices you get.
You can also add photos or a short video. Pros understand the job much faster when they can see it.
Say who brings the materials: you, the pro, or choose Not sure, and the pro can advise you.
Tap Next.
Step two: when and where.
Choose when you need it: as soon as possible, on a date, or flexible, to agree a time with the pro.
Tap Pin my current location if you are at the job now. If not, tap Choose on a map, and put the pin on the place.
Add a landmark or directions, so the pro finds the place easily.
Step three: the price.
Choose how to price it. We recommend this one: pros who can do it send you their price, and you choose.
Or set your own price, in Liberian dollars or US dollars. The first pro to accept at your price gets the job.
In this video, we let the pros send their prices.
Then choose how you will pay. With Protected by Trothen, your money is held safely, and the pro is paid only when you say the job is done.
We choose Protected by Trothen.
Step four: check everything.
Read your job once more. To change anything, tap Change next to it.
When it is right, tap Post my job.
Pros near you are told about it, and they answer with their prices. You can read each pro's reviews, then choose one.
Never pay a pro outside Trothen. If you do, we cannot protect your money.

title: Add Mobile Money
tagline: How you pay, and why your money is safe
transcript: In this video, you will add Mobile Money, so you can pay for jobs, rides and goods on Trothen.
Tap Payments at the bottom of the screen.
This is your Payments page. Your ways to pay are at the top, and everything you have paid is listed below.
Tap Add Payment Method.
Choose Mobile Money. If you would rather pay with a bank card, choose Card instead.
Type your Mobile Money number: the phone number your wallet is on.
Choose your network: Orange Money or MTN Mobile Money.
Say whose number it is. You can pay from a family member's or your company's wallet, if they agree.
Check the name the wallet is registered in. It helps if a payment ever needs to be traced.
Tap Save Payment Method.
When you pay, you get a message on your phone to approve the payment with your Mobile Money PIN. Trothen never asks for your PIN.
Your money is then held by Trothen. The pro is paid only when you confirm the job is done. If there is a problem, tap Report a Problem, and we step in.
At any time, you can download all your payments as a PDF, for your records.

title: Book a ride
tagline: A motorbike, keke, car or van, with the fare in L$ before you book
transcript: In this video, you will book a ride: a motorbike, a keke, a car or a van. You see the fare before you book.
Tap More at the bottom of the screen. It lists every part of your account.
Tap Rides.
First, say where the driver should pick you up.
Tap Use my location. Your phone asks if Trothen may see where you are: tap Allow.
Give the place a name or a landmark that drivers know.
You can add a note for the driver, like the colour of the gate, or what you are wearing.
Tap Save this place if you often leave from here. Next time, it is one tap.
Then, say where you are going.
Search for the place, or tap Choose on a map and put the pin where you are going.
Choose how many people are riding. A motorbike carries one passenger.
Tap Find drivers near me.
Each ride shows its fare in Liberian dollars, and how far away the driver is. The fare is fixed before you book.
Choose one and confirm. The driver is told at once, and you see them coming on the map.
You can call or text the driver in the app. Neither of you sees the other's phone number.
When the driver arrives, check the plate number. Give your four-digit PIN only if the plate matches. The trip starts then.
At the end, the fare is paid, and you can rate your driver. If anything went wrong, tap Report a Problem on the trip.

title: Find and buy in the Market
tagline: Search, check the details and buy with protection
transcript: In this video, you will find something in the Market, check it carefully, and buy it safely.
Tap More at the bottom of the screen. It lists every part of your account.
Tap Market.
The Market has goods from stores on Trothen, and things people sell themselves.
Type what you are looking for. You can search for details too, for example 128 gigabytes, or a brand.
Tap Search.
Each card shows the price, the condition, and the main details. Compare a few before you choose.
Tap a good to see everything about it.
Look at all the photos. They should show the real item, not a picture from the internet.
Read the details: storage, memory, network, warranty, and more. Make sure it is what you need.
Not sure about something? Message the seller before you buy. Never send money outside Trothen.
When you are happy, tap Add to cart.
Then pay from your cart. Your payment is held by Trothen until you have the goods in your hands.
If the goods do not arrive, or are not as described, tap Report a Problem on the order, and we help you get your money back.

title: Your cart and checkout
tagline: One cart for every store, with the total before you pay
transcript: In this video, you will use your cart: add goods, check them, and pay for them, with the delivery.
Tap More at the bottom of the screen. It lists every part of your account.
Tap Market.
Tap Add to cart on any good. You can add goods from different stores to the same cart.
Tap Cart.
Here is everything in your cart, grouped by store, with the price of each good.
Change the quantity if you need more than one. Or tap Save for later, to keep a good without buying it now.
At checkout, choose how to get your goods: collect them from the store, or have a driver bring them.
If a driver brings them, you see the delivery price before you pay. For heavy goods, like cement, only a vehicle that can carry them is offered.
You see the full total, with every fee, before you pay. Nothing is added afterwards.
When the driver arrives, check the goods, then give them your code. Only then is the store paid.

Choose the category. The details buyers look for in that category then appear below.
Choose the condition honestly: new, like new, good, or used. Buyers can return goods that are not as described.
Type your price. Look at similar items in the Market first, to choose a fair price.
Fill in the details below, like the brand and the power. Listings with details sell faster.
Confirm that the item is yours to sell. Selling stolen goods is against the law, and the account is closed.
Add clear photos of the real item, from a few sides. Then tap Put it on sale.
Some listings are checked by our team before they appear. That keeps the Market safe for everyone.

title: Messages and calls
tagline: Talk to a pro, a seller or a driver without sharing your number
transcript: In this video, you will send a message, a voice message, and make a call, all inside Trothen.
Tap Messages at the bottom of the screen.
Each conversation is with one pro, seller or driver. The newest are at the top.
Tap a conversation to open it.
Type your message in the box at the bottom.
Tap Send.
Rather talk? Hold the microphone to record a voice message, then let go to send it.
You can also call, or make a video call, from the top of the conversation.
Nobody sees your phone number. Keep your talks in Trothen: if there is a disagreement later, we can help, because we can see what was agreed.
If someone is rude, or asks you to pay outside Trothen, report them from the conversation.

title: Your account, settings and data
tagline: Your details, password, sounds, your data, or closing your account
transcript: In this video, you will look after your account: your details, your password, and your data.
Tap More at the bottom of the screen. It lists every part of your account.
Tap Settings.
At the top are your details: your name, email, phone and address. Change any of them, then tap Save Changes.
Moving? Change your country, county and city here, so we show you pros near you.
To change your password, type your current password, then your new password twice.
Lost your phone, or think someone knows your password? Tap Sign out of all devices. Then sign in again on your own phone.
Choose whether people can call you in the app, and at what times.
Choose your ringtone and your message sound. Tap Play to hear them.
Tap Download a copy of my data to get everything Trothen holds about you, in one file.
And if you ever want to leave, you can close your account here. Your personal data is then removed.

title: Add a good to your store
tagline: Photos, price, details and sizes, the way buyers want them
transcript: In this video, you will add a good to your store, with everything buyers want to know.
Tap More at the bottom of the screen. It lists every part of your account.
Tap My Store.
This is your store. Your goods are listed here, with their stock and their orders.
Tap Add a good.
Give it a clear name: what it is, the model, and the colour. Buyers search for these words.
Choose the currency: Liberian dollars or US dollars.
Type your price.
Add photos of the real good: up to four, on a plain background, in good light.
Choose the Market category. The details for that kind of good then appear.
Fill in the details buyers look for. For a phone: the storage,
the SIM,
and whether it works on any network.
For clothes and shoes, you can add sizes and a size chart. For building materials, the size, the length or the bag weight.
Be accurate. If a good is not as described, the buyer can return it, and you pay for the return.
When everything is right, tap Save.
A store manager checks every new good before buyers can see it, usually within a day. You are told when it is approved.

title: Deliver for stores and the Market
tagline: Your vehicle, your range, and fares in L$
transcript: In this video, you will set yourself up to deliver goods for stores and the Market, and earn from each trip.
Tap More at the bottom of the screen. It lists every part of your account.
Tap Deliveries.
Choose what you deliver with: a motorbike, a keke, a car, a van, or a truck.
For a motorbike, keke, car or van, Trothen's fares in Liberian dollars are used. You see examples of what you earn for each trip.
Choose the longest trip you will take, in kilometres.
You are only offered deliveries your vehicle can carry. Heavy goods, like cement, go to vans and trucks.
Tap Save.
When a delivery is offered, you see where to collect it, where it is going, and what you earn. Accept it, or let it go.
At the store, enter the pickup code and take a photo of the goods. At the door, check the buyer's code, and take another photo.
You are paid as soon as the buyer has the goods. The photos protect you if anyone says something went wrong.

title: Business tools
tagline: Expenses, quotes and invoices for your work
transcript: In this video, you will use the business tools, to keep your records and send quotes and invoices.
Tap More at the bottom of the screen. It lists every part of your account.
Tap Business Tools.
Tap Expenses.
Add each thing you spend for your work, like materials or fuel, with a photo of the receipt.
At the end of the month, you see what you earned, what you spent, and what is left. It helps with your taxes too.
Tap Quotes and estimates.
Write a quote for a customer: each part of the work, and its price. The customer sees it in their account.
When the customer agrees, turn the quote into an invoice with one tap. The customer pays it through Trothen.
Every quote and invoice can be downloaded as a PDF, with your name on it.
